metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Bernardo Rubin

plugins.name: claude-pro-skills
plugins.description: Claude Code toolkit: confidence-scored code reviews (PR, local, or full-repo audit), git workflow shortcuts, PR/Slack helpers, Claude meta skills, Jira integration, and per-project knowledge vaults. All skills invocable with no prefix.

plugins.name: usage-bars
plugins.description: Two bars above the prompt: context window used and what's left of the 5-hour rate-limit window. Terminal and desktop.

plugins.name: slack-drafts
plugins.description: A /slack-drafts pane for the Slack drafts /write-slack-message saves: Slack-safe copy on the Mac, and an optional phone page to paste them from your iPhone with links intact.

plugins.name: quick-replies
plugins.description: Turns Claude's "Next steps" and "I need from you" lists into Go ahead, Yes / No buttons and reply boxes above the prompt, sent back as one message.
